class_guess: Bell eats counter: unary left pair + binary right counter; reset absorbs counter digits
summary: Left pair (110)^a 0 (011)^n trades 1 block/trip; right binary counter +1 per 2 trips; reset at n<=2 grows L
mechanism: Tape = 0^inf (110)^a 0 (011)^n, then a binary counter Q at the right end (3-cell digits, LSB nearest the head).
One trip = zig-zag from the right end to the a|n boundary and back: a+1, n-1. Q gets +1 every 2nd trip.
At n = 1 or 2: reset (two full sweeps), a restarts at 2 and L = a+n grows. Trips ignore Q; the reset ignores a.
